_metadata.description: Reviewer-signed corrections for DSLD product rows where label text, a source identifier, or a quantity unit contains a verified transcription or attribution defect.
_metadata.purpose: Per-product source-row correction with provenance. Each entry targets one (dsld_id, raw_ingredient_text) pair before cleaner identity resolution and may correct label text, a misattributed UNII, a verified quantity unit, or a combination of those fields. Global aliases and global identifier suppression are not supported.
_metadata.scope: Only fires for an exact (dsld_id, raw_ingredient_text) tuple match. Case-sensitive on raw_ingredient_text by design — manufacturers may print 'Insulin' in one product and 'INSULIN' in another, and each needs independent reviewer sign-off because the surrounding context (sibling ingredients, product category, regulatory status) must be re-evaluated per occurrence.
_metadata.review_policy: Every product entry is keyed by dsld_id and must carry: brand, product_name (for human-readable audit trail), raw_ingredient_text (the source row being corrected), corrected_ingredient_text (the text the cleaner should see, unchanged for unit-only corrections), correction_fields, evidence (free-text rationale with regulatory citations), sources (authoritative URLs — FDA, NIH, DailyMed, etc.), reviewer, and review_date (ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD). A verified cross-row defect may add additional_row_corrections, which inherit the product-level evidence, sources, reviewer, review_date, scope, and provenance tag. Quantity-unit changes require exact raw_quantity_unit and corrected_quantity_unit values and must be supported by the official label image.
_metadata.unmatched_drug_tokens_policy: When a row's raw_ingredient_text matches a known regulated-drug name (e.g., 'Insulin', 'Acetaminophen', 'Ibuprofen') and there is NO matching override for the product, the row must NOT be silently mapped. The cleaner emits the row to a quarantine path with reason='requires_human_review_drug_token_in_supplement' and excludes the product from scoring. New occurrences enter the reviewer pipeline via the same schema.

69734.product_name: GNC Women's Ultra Mega Active Vanilla
69734.evidence: Label printing/transcription error. Sibling ingredients in the same fiber-blend cell (Inositol, Fructooligosaccharides (FOS), Gum Acacia, Cellulose Gum, MCT Oil) make the fiber context unambiguous; 'Insulin' is the dictionary-nearest misprint of 'Inulin' (fructan fiber, FDA-recognized dietary fiber). Insulin itself is a hormone biologic regulated under FDA's Biologics Price Competition and Innovation Act (BPCIA, post-2020 transition from new-drug applications to biologic-license applications) and cannot legally appear on a US dietary-supplement label. Independent online cross-check confirms the same product is listed elsewhere with 'Inulin' rather than 'Insulin'.
69734.reviewer: PharmaGuide clinical review (Sean Cheick, owner of record)

259789.evidence: The live DSLD JSON API reports the Iodine quantities as 150 mg and 75 mg, but the official DSLD label PDF prints 150 mcg per two-caplet serving and 75 mcg per one-caplet serving. This product-scoped correction repairs the API transcription unit before dose conversion; the numeric quantities and nutrient identity are unchanged.
259789.reviewer: PharmaGuide data integrity review (Sean Cheick, owner of record)

299037.evidence: The live DSLD JSON API crosses the two names in this label hierarchy: it assigns the 1000 mg source-material amount and elemental-magnesium UNII to a row named Magnesium, then assigns the 72 mg amount with 17% Daily Value to a nested row named Magtein Magnesium L-Threonate. The official DSLD label PDF prints Magnesium 72 mg (17% DV) from 1000 mg Magtein magnesium L-threonate. These exact product-row corrections restore the printed hierarchy before identity resolution; the unsupported elemental UNII is removed from the source-material row rather than transferred by inference.
299037.reviewer: PharmaGuide data integrity review (Sean Cheick, owner of record)

328117.product_name: Alive! Women's 50+ Multivitamin Gummy Mixed Berry Flavored
328117.evidence: The live DSLD JSON API reports Boron as 150 mg, but the official DSLD label PDF prints Boron (as sodium borate) at 150 mcg per two-gummy serving. This product-scoped correction repairs the API transcription unit before dose conversion; the numeric quantity and nutrient identity are unchanged.
328117.reviewer: PharmaGuide data integrity review (Sean Cheick, owner of record)

59047.evidence: FDA Substance Registration System identifies DTI67O9503 as alglucosidase alfa, a distinct human lysosomal alpha-glucosidase biologic. The DSLD row itself names Transglucosidase, classifies it as an enzyme, identifies Aspergillus niger as its source, and reports transglucosidase activity units. The source UNII is therefore misattributed and is removed rather than replaced with an unverified identifier.
59047.reviewer: PharmaGuide data integrity review (Sean Cheick, owner of record)

64551.evidence: The official DSLD label image prints 'Tropical Almond (Terminalia chebula) 500 mg'. The DSLD JSON API row retained only 'Tropical Almond', omitting the parenthetical Latin identity and leaving an otherwise ambiguous common name. This correction restores the source label text exactly before cleaner identity resolution; it does not create a global alias for bare 'Tropical Almond'.
64551.reviewer: PharmaGuide data integrity review (Sean Cheick, owner of record)
